app.workspace-manager.title: Workspace Manager
app.workspace-manager.empty.select: Select a workspace to view its settings
app.workspace-manager.nodes.engineSettin: The saved engine settings are not applied yet
app.workspace-manager.nodes.notReported: Has not reported its state yet
app.workspace-manager.field.name: Name
app.workspace-manager.field.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.
app.workspace-manager.field.autoStart: Start automatically when the cluster starts
app.workspace-manager.field.autoStartHin: The initial state when the cluster starts with every node stopped. When off, the workspace stays stopped until you start it here. A node joining a running cluster follows the cluster.
app.workspace-manager.engines.restartNot: Engine changes take effect on every node after the workspace is restarted.
app.workspace-manager.engines.pendingNot: Some nodes do not run with the saved engine settings yet. Restart to apply them on every node.
app.workspace-manager.progress.phase.cre: Creating the "{name}" workspace. This may take a few minutes.
app.workspace-manager.progress.phase.sta: Starting the "{name}" workspace services on every node. This may take a few minutes.
app.workspace-manager.progress.phase.sto: Stopping the "{name}" workspace services on every node…
app.workspace-manager.progress.failedGen: The operation failed. See the server log for details.
app.workspace-manager.dialog.createDesc: Creates a new workspace and starts its services on every node. The workspace name appears in URLs and cannot be changed later.
app.workspace-manager.dialog.deleteDesc: The workspace "{name}" and everything stored in it will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
app.workspace-manager.dialog.restartDesc: The engine settings have been saved. Restart the "{name}" workspace on every node to apply them? Its services are briefly unavailable while it restarts.
